description:
Goal
Make the fz-f98 failure contract explicit before repairing code: one focused red suite must prove the shared Enum.reduce* bridge loses callable identity over non-List Enumerables and must expose the deciding facts directly.

Signal
Current spikes:
- fz2 interp fixtures2/behavior/enum_tier0.fz panics at transport.rs:2587: local callable producer reached transport without upstream CallableFlowFact: FunctionId(66), captures [].
- fz2 run/build fixtures2/behavior/enum_tier0.fz fail native lowering: CallableId(3) names multiple boundaries [0,1,2].
- fz2 interp fixtures2/00180_enum_reduce_range.fz fails: backend executable expected 2 runtime lanes, got 3.
- fz2 run fixtures2/00180_enum_reduce_range.fz panics at native_codegen/driver.rs:971 with one closure target surface carrying capture_count 1 and another capture_count 0.
- range_enumerable and map_enumerable pass; direct Enumerable impls are not the root.

Required work
- Add or re-enable focused red fixtures for fz-bfh.1/.2/.3/.4 with path deferrals tied to fz-f98 until the fix lands.
- Add telemetry or test capture that reports, for a callable producer, its producer identity, captures, direct surfaces, first-class surfaces, resolutions, and the transport CallableId/BoundaryIds derived from it.
- State the paper contract in the test names: one producer-minted callable flow projects one coherent callable contract independent of collection-state lane prefix.

Checks
- The focused fz-f98 contract tests fail for the current reason, not by timeout noise.
- Existing transport direct-reducer tests remain green.
title: Pin fz-f98 reduce-bridge regression contract and telemetry
